title: Certain EPUB translation modes may skip non-paragraph elements
symptom: Current upstream documentation says conversational/JSON-schema endpoints auto-classify EPUB elements. Only non-conversational translation engines or explicitly disabled/failed classification can fall back to the configured --translate-tags list (default p).
user_impact: On this limited route, headings, verse or other non-p text may remain untranslated unless included explicitly.

steps: Use automatic plan classification on capable conversational endpoints; for --plan-classify none or non-conversational MT engines, configure --translate-tags to cover the book structure and inspect the plan/output.

remaining_question: How much non-p content is omitted by non-conversational MT routes, compared with automatic classification?
verification_plan: Run synthetic licensed EPUB fixtures with h1/h2/p/div through distinct --plan-classify auto/none and fixed MT route modes; compare segment coverage by mode.
